issue.title: Build Cloud Sync Status Icon
issue.body: Fluent needs a persistent, tappable sync status icon in the navigation bar that communicates both connectivity and sync state at a glance. The icon reflects five states across an online/offline × synced/syncing/pending matrix. Tapping the icon is the sole entry point to the Sync page. ### Functional Requirements - Navigation Bar Icon - Place a cloud sync status icon in the top-right navigation bar area. - The icon changes based on the current sync state (see states below). - Online states render at full color (green/blue); offline states render the same icons in gray (`#A0A0A0`). - Tapping the icon navigates to the Sync page. - Online - synced - Icon: `li:cloud-check`, cloud white, checkmark green (`#17B26A`) - Online - syncing - Icon: `li:cloud` with `li:refresh-cw` overlay (arrows static), cloud white, arrows green (`#17B26A`) - Online - pending upload - Icon: `li:cloud-upload`, cloud white, arrow yellow (`#E48F06`, same in dark mode) - Offline - synced - Icon: `li:cloud-check`, #A0A0A0 - Offline - pending upload - Icon: `custom icon attached`, #A0A0A0 > **Note:** The Sync page must be built before this ticket can be completed - tapping the icon is the only way to reach that page. > **Note 2:** "Online" means the app can reach the Fluent server, not just that the device has a network connection. Offline states apply whenever the server is unreachable regardless of network availability. > **Note 3:** The syncing state uses a two-icon composition (`li:cloud` + `li:refresh-cw`). The arrows are static in the nav bar — animated rotation belongs on the Sync page. If the composition approach takes too much time, ask Product for a single-icon alternative.
